    Tangent directions at a point of maximum geometric rank #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.map_ker_le_range_of_maximal_extended_rank {k : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [Field k] [AddCommGroup T] [Module k T] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [Module.Finite k W] [Module.Finite k T] (F : Type u_5) [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Infinite F] (Φ : T →ₗ[k] V →ₗ[k] W) (p : T) (hmax : ∀ (q : TensorProduct k F T), Module.finrank F ↥((baseChangeBilinear F Φ) q).range ≤ Module.finrank k ↥(Φ p).range) (h : T) :
    Submodule.map (Φ h) (Φ p).ker ≤ (Φ p).range

    If the rank at a ground point bounds every rank after extension to an infinite field, each direction carries its kernel into its image.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.map_ker_le_range_of_maximal_geometric_rank {k : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [Field k] [AddCommGroup T] [Module k T] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [Module.Finite k W] [Module.Finite k T] (Φ : T →ₗ[k] V →ₗ[k] W) (p : T) (hmax : ∀ (q : TensorProduct k (AlgebraicClosure k) T), Module.finrank (AlgebraicClosure k) ↥((baseChangeBilinear (AlgebraicClosure k) Φ) q).range ≤ Module.finrank k ↥(Φ p).range) (h : T) :
    Submodule.map (Φ h) (Φ p).ker ≤ (Φ p).range

    At a point of maximum rank over the algebraic closure, every member of a linear family takes the kernel at that point into the image at that point.
